18/06/2020 keep showing 
"Your connection to VrChat timed out" and leave to home and need to join back every 3 minutes.
Having the exact same issue along with one of my friends right now. We timed out, and we can no longer log in.
issues reproduced in build 5186443, even with VPN, 10 times out of 10 since July 1.
Currently getting this bug, I just entered credentials, it loads for like 10 seconds and then makes a boop sound and loads again infinitely
Fixed when turning off vpn though....

@{5f2f96212b921879a513ecd6|full_name}: I got this issue just last night, everything before the update was fine, since the update, its been more often, like every 5 minutes in world BAM socked back to home, then 4 minutes laters "BEEP" and VRC becomes unresponsive

I started having this very issue on 8/15/2020, which was about a couple weeks in VRChat with my brand new Quest 1. At first I didn't worry about it too much because the bug had occurred randomly; thus, making it fairly difficult to file a report. 
Nowadays, however, I can't even get to my Home World without waiting for 5-10 minutes on loading loop; and even then, I cannot manage to enter most Worlds, Public or Private, in Lab or not, no matter how much I try (I have a 20 minute recording of me trying to join friends with no luck whatsoever). I can't even join my friends without rolling a dice, and the outcome is often more dispiriting then expected.
I absolutely **love** VRChat to death, and that is the biggest reason why I am so devastated to be in a position like this. If there are any officials reading this post, please note that I would not hesitate to turn in my Quest 1 to your team at all if it will help you guys evaluate the matter here more efficiently.

First time doing video editing! I hope this video illustrates both, an example and the depth of this issue. 
https://s3.arkjp.net/misskey/831cd8a6-0bf4-4756-9d52-178f6068a1f1.webm

So, I have purchased a Valve Index for playing VRChat, but it seems that I am still getting this issue. Thankfully-however, I can actually submit logs via SteamVR this time! I hope this helps!
https://gist.githubusercontent.com/KawaneRio/f7717a99b9d85f2784de07dbf4b5fc60/raw/33f0994b5da268147c562d23dc7104d329e70b6f/SteamVR-2020-12-28-AM_08_30_24.txt
Note: the `Unable to find input 'z' in filter click_button_actions_legacy_17_user_hand_left_input_thumbstick` log spam is a known bug from SteamVR.

Every 2-3 hours I get the timeout loop. and before that player avatars dont seem to load but i can hear them talk. If i want to change worlds then it times out. its really annooying since when im streaming i loose my immersion when i get timed out and have to start from scratch

So it's been a while since the last time I got this issue. The problem seemed to be my internet connection, which, at the time of December 2020, was around 2Mbps. Switching to a better ISP seemed to fix the problem for the most part. Although not stuck in a timeout loop like last year, I do still get errors like:
```
2021.07.15 04:36:39 Error      -  [Behaviour] Error posting visit:
Response was null.
Connection timed out!
```
quite often. However, I am unsure whether this should be filed under a separate canny or not (since I am already seeing more than one file reports regarding connection issues).

Post is too generic/omnibus post. Closing due to age. 
If you have a similar issue please make a new post.
